posts.message: Troop 77 Scout Russ Thomas!  Great job Russ!!!
Oct 2026 - Troop 77 scouts and leaders representing the troop helping Pack 7 AOL scouts with skills and leading the bike rides. We appreciate you all going out to help and model Troop life.

Nov 2026 - Alafia State Park Cycling Campout.   We had 8 scouts (and 3 leaders) complete the 22mile mountain biking ride needed for the cycling merit badge!  The rest of the scouts spent their time on the more difficult trails.  Unfortunately we did have a crash and a scout with a broken arm.   We camped a few miles away at TLC Gypsy Haven Horse Farm.  As always, ended the campout with our multi-denominational chuch service.

Troop 77’s new website is live. Some work still to complete. But after a dead site for several years it’s nice to have one back up!

Www.BSATroop77.com

Three new Eagles in Troop 77!  
Adam A in late August, and Brent B and Brian P this week!

Congratulations to all of you!
